book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu u sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔrɑbun ɡɑri mɔ̀
Yesu yɑrɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun di. Sɑnɑm mɛ u doonɔ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ win mi bu kɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑ yerun bɑnɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i yɑbu ye kpuro wɑ? Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ bɑ koo ye kpuro surɑ, bɑɑ kpee teeru tɑ ǹ ko n sɔndi ten tensim wɔllɔ.
Wɑhɑlɑ ye yɑ koo nɑ hɑnduniɑ yu sere kpe

Yesu u sɔ̃ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Olifin wɔllɔ. Yerɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ win mi be tɔnɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɔ ǹ n dommɑn nɑ yɑbu ye, yɑ koo koorɑ kɑ yĩre te tɑ koo wunɛn nɑɑru kɑ hɑnduniɑn kpeeru sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i n tii sɛ kpɑ ɡoo u ku rɑɑ bɛɛ nɔni wɔ̃ke.
Domi tɔn dɑbirɑ koo nɑ kɑ nɛn yĩsiru bɑ n mɔ̀, beyɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ, kpɑ bu tɔn dɑbiru nɔni wɔ̃ke.
I ko i n tɑbun dɑmu dɑmusu nɔɔmɔ. I ku de n bɛɛ bɛrum ko. Yeni yɑ ǹ koo ko yɑ kun koore, ɑdɑmɑ n ǹ ɡinɑ hɑnduniɑn kpeeru mi.
Bwesenu koo seesinɑ nu tɑbu ko, sinɑmbɑ koo tɑbu seesinɑ. Gɔ̃ɔru kɑ tem yĩiribu ko n wɑ̃ɑ berɑ kɑ berɑ.
Ye kpuro yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn kurɔn nuku wuriribun tore.
Tɔmbɑ koo bɛɛ ɡɑbu nɔmu sɔndiɑ bu bɛɛ tɔ̃yɑ ko kpɑ bu bɛɛ ɡo. Bwesenu kpuro nu koo bɛɛ tusi nɛn yĩsirun sɔ̃.
Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, tɔn dɑbirɑ koo biru wurɑ. Bɑ koo kɔrumɔtɔnu kuɑnɑ kpɑ bu tusinɑ.
Sɔmɔ weesuɡii dɑbirɑ koo yɑrimɑ bu tɔn dɑbinu nɔni wɔ̃ke.
Kɔ̃sɑn kobu koo dɑbiɑ sere tɔn dɑbi dɑbinun kĩrɑ koo yɛmiɑ.
Adɑmɑ wi u tɛmɑnɑ sere kɑ nɔrɔ, wiyɑ u koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Gusunɔn bɑndun Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ yeni yɑ koo nɔɔrɑ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ, kpɑ yu ko seedɑ bwesenu kpuron mi. Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔrɑ kpeerɑbu koo tunumɑ.
Gɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunun ɡɑri
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Dɑniɛli u rɑɑ “Kɑm koosion bwɑ̃ɑroku kɔ̃sun” ɡɑri kuɑ. Geyɑ i ko wɑ ɡɑ yɔ̃ yɑm dɛɛrɑm sɔɔ. Wi u tire teni ɡɑrimɔ, u tubuo sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ n weenɛ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yudeɑɔ bu duki su bu dɑ ɡuunu ɡiɑ.
Wi u wɑ̃ɑ dii tɛɛrɑn wɔllɔ u ku rɑɑ sɑre u du dirɔ u yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ.
Wi u mɑɑ woo ɡberɔ u ku ɡɔsirɑ yɛnuɔ u kɑ win kumbooro suɑ.
Amɔnɑ kurɔ ben wɑhɑlɑ ko n nɛ sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, be bɑ ɡuri mɔ kɑ be bɑ bibu bɔm kɛ̃mɔ.
I Gusunɔ kɑnɔ kpɑ bɛɛn kpikirun sɑnɑm mu kun sɑ̃ɑ woorun sɑɑ ǹ kun mɛ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ.
Domi sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ, nɔni swɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑrɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ tèn bweseru tɑ ǹ koore sɑɑ hɑnduniɑn toren di sere kɑ ɡisɔ. Ten bweserɑ kun mɑm mɑɑ sisi.
Gusunɔ ù kun dɑɑ sɑnɑm mɛ kɑwe ɡoo kun tiɑrɔ. Adɑmɑ u mu kɑwɑwɑ be u ɡɔsɑn sɔ̃.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ɡoo ù n bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Kirisi wi, u wɑ̃ɑ mini, ǹ kun mɛ u wɑ̃ɑ ɡiɔ, i ku rɑ nɑɑnɛ ko.
Domi Kirisi weesuɡibu kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ weesuɡibɑ koo yɑri. Bɑ koo yĩre bɑkɑnu kɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡiɑ ko bu kɑ tɔmbu nɔni wɔ̃ke, kɑ mɑm be Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ, ǹ n ko n koorɑ.
N wee, nɑ bɛɛ ye sɔ̃ɔwɑ yɑ sere nɑ.
Bɑ̀ n mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ, wee u wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑburɔ, i ku dɑ mi. Nɡe bɑ̀ n bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ, wee u wɑ̃ɑ dii sɔɔwɔ, i ku rɑ nɑɑnɛ ko.
Nɡe mɛ ɡuru mɑɑkinu rɑ bɑlli wɔllɔ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di n kɑ dɑ duu yerɔ, nɡe mɛyɑ Tɔnun Biin nɑɑru tɑ ko n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yɑm mi ɡorɑ wɑ̃ɑ, miyɑ yɑberekunu koo mɛnnɑ.
Tɔnun Biin nɑɑru
Mɑ Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛn nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun biru, mii mii sɔ̃ɔ koo yɑm tĩrɑ, suru kun mɑɑ win yɑm bururɑm sɔ̃ɔsimɔ, kperi koo wɔrumɑ wɔllun di kpɑ wɔllun dɑm mu yĩiri.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Tɔnun Biin yĩrerɑ koo kurɑ wɔllɔ. Hɑnduniɑn bwesenu kpuro nu koo swĩ. Nu koo Tɔnun Bii wɑ u wee wɔllun di ɡuru wiru sɔɔ kɑ dɑm bɑkɑm kɑ yiiko.
Kɔbi bɑkɑ koo swĩ kpɑ u win wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ ɡɔri hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ sɔɔ. Bɑ koo be u ɡɔsɑ mɛnnɑ hɑnduniɑ kpuron di.
Yĩre te dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ fiɡie
tɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, i de n bɛɛ yeeri ye dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ fiɡie tɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ. Sɑɑ mìn di ten kɑ̃ɑsi dwiiyɑ mɑ tɑ kpɑrɑru torumɑ, i yɛ̃ mɑ tombururɑ tɑ turuku kuɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɛɛ mɑɑ, ì n yɑbu ye kpuro wɑ, i n yɛ̃ mɑ sɑɑ yɑ sisi yɑ turuku koomɑ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɛ̃ ben kpuro kun ɡbimɔ yɑbu ye kpuro yu kɑ tunumɑ.
Wɔllu kɑ tem bɑɑ yɑ koo doonɑ, ɑdɑmɑ nɛn ɡɑri kun dɔɔnɔ pɑi.
Gusunɔ turowɑ
hɑnduniɑn kpeerun sɑɑ yɛ̃
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, ye n sɑ̃ɑ nɛn nɑɑrun sɑɑ, ɡoo sɑri wi u yen tɔ̃ru yɛ̃, bɑɑ ɡɔrɑdobɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ, bɑɑ mɑm Biin tii, mɑ n kun mɔ Bɑɑbɑ turo.
Nɡe mɛ n kuɑ Nɔwɛn sɑɑ, mɛyɑ n ko n mɑɑ ko sɑnɑm mɛ Tɔnun Bii u koo nɑ.
Geemɑ nim yibu bɑkɑ te, tu sere nɑ, tɔmbɑ dimɔ bɑ nɔrumɔ bɑ kurɔ kpɑɑnu mɔ̀, bɑ ben bibu durɔbu kɛ̃mɔ sere dɔmɑ te Nɔwɛ duɑ ɡoo sɔɔ.
Bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu bwisikɑ sere nim yibu bɑkɑ te, tɑ kɑ turɑ tɑ kɑ bu doonɑ kpuro. Nɡe mɛyɑ n ko n sɑ̃ɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Tɔnun Bii u koo nɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ tɔmbu yiru bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ ɡberɔ. Bɑ koo turo suɑ bu turo deri.
Tɔn kurɔbu yiru bɑ ko n nɑmmɔ. Bɑ koo turo suɑ bu turo deri.
Yen sɔ̃, i n swɑɑ mɛɛrɑ domi i ǹ yɛ̃ tɔ̃ɔ te bɛɛn Yinni u koo tunumɑ.
I de yeni yu bɛɛ yeeri. Yɛnu yɛ̃ro ù n yɛ̃ wɔ̃kurun sɑɑ ye ɡbɛnɔ u koo nɑ, u koo dom se kpɑ u ku de u du win yɛnuɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛn tii i n sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ domi Tɔnun Bii u koo nɑwɑ sɑɑ ye i ǹ bwisikɑ.
Yoo nɑɑnɛɡii
kɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑriruɡii
Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, wɑrɑ sɑ̃ɑ yoo lɑɑkɑriɡii wi u nɑɑnɛ mɔ. Wiyɑ wi win yinni u win sɔm kowo be bɑ tie nɔmu sɔndiɑ, u kɑ bu nɔɔri sɑɑ ye n weenɛ.
Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ sɔm kowo wi, win yinni ù n deemɑ u mɔ̀ mɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ u koo wurɑmɑ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, yinni wi, u koo win dukiɑ kpuro sɔm kowo wi nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Adɑmɑ ù n sɑ̃ɑ sɔm kowo kɑm, mɑ u bwisikumɔ u mɔ̀, win yinni tɛɛmɔ,
mɑ u seemɔ u win sɔm kowosibu soomɔ, mɑ u dimɔ u nɔrumɔ kɑ tɑm nɔrobu sɑnnu,
win yinni koo wurɑmɑ dɔmɑ te u ǹ nùn yĩiyɔ kɑ sɑɑ ye u ǹ yɛ̃.
Kpɑ u nùn bɔɔri kpiri kpirikɑ kpɑ u dɑ u kɑ murɑfitibɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru bɔnu ko. Miyɑ u koo wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi u swĩ.
